title: 换入/换出的 Block 数

standard.summary: 将指定数量的 transformer block 权重换出到 CPU 内存，只在需要时换入 GPU，降低 VRAM 峰值。
standard.effect: 每个 block 约占 400MB~2GB VRAM（取决于模型），换出 N 个 block 可节省相应 VRAM。代价是训练速度下降（PCIe 传输开销）。
standard.whenToUse: 显存不足但不想用 gradient_checkpointing 时的替代方案；或两者结合使用以最大化显存节省。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足时无需使用（会降低训练速度）。

standard_en.summary: Swaps the weights of a given number of transformer blocks out to CPU memory and pulls them back to the GPU only when needed, lowering peak VRAM.
standard_en.effect: Each block takes roughly 400MB-2GB of VRAM depending on the model, so swapping N blocks saves that much. The cost is slower training (PCIe transfer overhead).
standard_en.whenToUse: As an alternative when VRAM is short but you would rather not use gradient_checkpointing, or combined with it to save as much as possible.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when VRAM is plentiful -- it only slows training down.

advanced.principle: 类似 CPU offload 但以整个 block 为单位。选择换出频率最低（离输出最远）的 block，最大化换出收益与换入开销比。
advanced.tradeoffs: block_swap 的速度开销取决于 PCIe 带宽。NVMe → GPU Direct Storage 可以绕过 CPU，提升传输速度（实验性）。

advanced_en.principle: Like CPU offload but at whole-block granularity. Chooses the blocks swapped out least often (farthest from the output), maximizing the swap-out benefit to swap-in cost ratio.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: block_swap's speed cost depends on PCIe bandwidth. NVMe → GPU Direct Storage can bypass the CPU to raise transfer speed (experimental).
